verdict.rationale: Carta's API uses OAuth 2.0 with a client-credentials grant, so an agent can authenticate without a user present. OAuth apps can have scopes added, and service-account-style applications can be attached to an Investment Firm, which together amount to scoped machine credentials. The evidence shows scopes exist but not how fine-grained they are, and nothing ties these credentials to agents specifically. Missing for 10: documented scope granularity (e.g. read-only or per-resource limits), agent-specific credential issuance or the auth model for the MCP plugins, revocation and rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
